summary: Completed backend and mobile-web regression testing for EQOband at 390x844. All four API tests and all requested UI flows passed.

integration_issues.issue: BLE scanning/telemetry hardware is a demo profile with placeholder UUIDs; microphone toggles permission-ready copy only and has no voice transport or spoken response. These are documented MOCKED integrations.

action_items: Replace placeholder BLE UUIDs and demo telemetry with native BLE scanning/notifications when firmware is available.
Provide a valid direct OpenAI Realtime credential and implement audio transport/TTS if real voice is required.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend and frontend use environment-based API configuration and visible fallback states; no critical code issues reproduced.
LLM requests may fall back to baseline when the configured budget is exceeded; endpoint still returns HTTP 200 as designed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview tested at 390x844. Dashboard, all five tabs, quick prompt, custom chat, microphone copy, device toggle, settings rows, and horizontal overflow check passed. Console capture showed no blocking runtime error. BLE and voice remain MOCKED/documented limitations.
rca_of_issue: No runtime defects reproduced. Initial test harness collection error was caused by not exporting frontend/.env in the shell, then passed after loading the configured EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Initial UI strictness issue was a test selector ambiguity for duplicate EQOAI text, resolved by selecting the first exact heading; not an app defect.
